goal: Write or update docs/PRD.md and docs/acceptance.json for the idea in docs/IDEA.md.

decisions.what: Spec the round as three apps chosen by an ordered rule table (R1 Map, R2 Business, R3 Explorer = the round 4 page), with R4-R7 added as rows before R3
decisions.why: Brief and IDEA ask exactly this; R4-R7 are reserved for round 6

decisions.what: Column roles map onto the existing types: G = one lat+lon pair, T = temporal, N = numerical without lat/lon, C = categorical, I = other; a dataset qualifies for every app whose rule holds, so Explorer always qualifies
decisions.why: Reuses the AC-3 classifier with no new type logic; the brief leaves the I versus C split open

decisions.what: Without an app parameter a dataset opens in its detected app; app=explorer gives the round 4 page exactly, and old page tests pass app=explorer
decisions.why: Lesson: keep the old default switchable so earlier tests stay valid

decisions.what: Drill-down reuses the round 4 f.<column> filters, and the leaderboard groups by the first categorical column that has no active filter
decisions.why: No new URL state or server path is needed, and Back and chips already work

decisions.what: Changed AC-16 so a donut is drawn only for 2 to 5 values
decisions.why: The global rule 'donut only for 2-5 parts' applies to Explorer too; rules.py allows 2 to 6 today

decisions.what: Reworded AC-39 to bar-only toggle and split AC-40 into clear sentences; kept AC-38 as it was
decisions.why: Gate 178 asked for the rewording; the AC-38 and AC-40 text in the file was complete, so the reported lost words were probably cut off in QA's prompt

decisions.what: Added AC-43 to AC-58, with archetype exports as Should and the rest as Must
decisions.why: These are the brief's 'Done when' items; exports are the least core part

decisions.what: team.json: trends off; designer, frontend and design_review on
decisions.why: The Board named designer + frontend + backend with trends off, and the round adds two new page layouts
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md last lines; gate 175 'Trends off = team setting only'

tried_and_failed.what: Editing acceptance.json with a Python script through Bash (heredoc, then /tmp script)
tried_and_failed.why_it_failed: The heredoc was blocked as brace expansion and python3 needed approval; used the Edit tool and checked the 58 entries with Grep instead

assumptions: Sparklines are part of a KPI card, not charts, so they get no table toggle
The primary amount and primary numeric are the first N column in column order
The Map app uses Plotly scattergeo on the bundled world_110m outline, with hexbin cells computed by the server (about 40 across the longitude span), so no new dependency
The round 4 filter form and chips stay on all apps; the Business KPI cards replace the round 4 KPI strip in the Business app
Explorer exports keep their current title and layout
A 200,000-row dataset opening as Business or Map must still meet AC-41 and AC-42
open_questions: Branding: no business website capture and no docs/brand/ folder (docs/reference/ only holds the deck.gl and unstructured.io library captures). Please confirm that gate 160 still holds: name DataBoot, plain neutral style, system sans font, no logo, blank SVG favicon. Or give a logo as an image link in the gate comment.

Business periods: is the default right? Grain comes from the date span (<=60 days = day, <=182 = ISO week, <=3 years = month, else year). The latest full period is the one ending on the last date, else the period before it.
Primary amount = the first numerical column, and KPI cards = the first up to 3 numerical columns, summed. Should the owner be able to pick the measure?
Drill-down goes to the next categorical column in column order, and at the last level bars do not drill. Is a different order wanted?
Top regions in the Map app = the first categorical column by row count. Should a country column be preferred when there is one?
When only Explorer qualifies, the 'View as' switch is hidden. Is that right?
AC-16 now draws a donut only for 2 to 5 values (was 2 to 6), as the global rule asks. Tests with a 6-value donut must change. Confirm?
Hexbin: about 40 cells across the points' longitude span, coloured by count. Is that acceptable?
Scope: the Business app (4 parts plus drill-down) and the Map app are a large round. If it must be smaller, move AC-56 (exports) to round 6.

lessons.lesson: When a gate says an AC is 'garbled', read the AC in acceptance.json and memory.md first: the file may be complete and the problem a truncated prompt. Fix only what really changed (here, the gate 178 bar-only toggle in AC-39).
lessons.when: Rewording round owed by a gate

lessons.lesson: In this image, Bash heredocs with braces and python3 commands may be blocked. Edit acceptance.json with the Edit tool and check it with a Grep count on the line pattern.
When a global rule in the idea conflicts with an existing AC (donut 2-5 vs AC-16's 2-6), change the AC in place and flag that old tests will break.
lessons.when: Global design rules applied to an existing app
